mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE id = #{ticketId}
SELECT category_id FROM tickets WHERE id = #{ticketId}
SELECT skill_tag_id FROM ticket_category_skills WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY skill_tag_id
SELECT parent_id FROM ticket_categories WHERE id = #{categoryId}

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.real_name, u.username, u.department_id, d.name AS department_name, u.status, hp.max_capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets active_ticket WHERE active_ticket.handler_id = u.id AND active_ticket.status IN ('PENDING_RESPONSE', 'PROCESSING')) AS current_load, hp.avg_response_minutes, hp.avg_resolution_minutes, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN done.resolved_at <= done.resolution_deadline THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM tickets done WHERE done.resolved_by_handler_id = u.id AND done.resolved_at IS NOT NULL), 50.00) AS sla_compliance_rate, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) FROM ticket_ratings r WHERE r.handler_id = u.id), 3.00) AS rating_score, st.id AS skill_id, st.name AS skill_name, hs.proficiency FROM handler_profiles hp INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = hp.user_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN handler_skills hs ON hs.handler_id = hp.id LEFT JOIN skill_tags st ON st.id = hs.skill_tag_id WHERE u.role = 1 AND u.status = 1 ORDER BY u.id, st.id
